input.rationale: Section 9 is the only warranty provision: subsection (a) is a mutual corporate-authority representation and subsection (b) is a Globix acknowledgment favouring the Company. Nothing warrants that HDI's design, development, implementation, operation, maintenance, management and hosting of the Site will be performed to any standard, conform to documentation, comply with law or be free of malicious code, and there is no repair, replacement or refund remedy. With no warranty period and no remedy the clause fails the fallback on a material term, and the rule directs that a missing express warranty be inserted. The insertion sits at the preferred position: professional and workmanlike Services warranted for 90 days, unqualified conformance of the Site, deliverables and software to documentation for 12 months, compliance with laws, no malicious code, and repair, replacement or refund remedies. Section 10.7 already lists Section 9 as surviving, so no survival edit is needed.

ops.text: HDI represents and warrants to the Company that (1) the design, development, implementation, operation, maintenance, management and hosting of the Site (collectively, the "Services") will be performed in a professional manner and in a workmanlike manner, and this warranty shall apply for a period of 90 days following performance of the applicable Services; (2) for a period of 12 months following the Company's written acceptance and approval of the Site pursuant to Section 5.2, the Site, each deliverable and each item of software delivered or used by HDI in performing the Services will conform to its documentation; (3) HDI's performance of the Services will comply with all applicable laws, rules and regulations; and (4) the Site and any software delivered or used by HDI in performing the Services will be free of any virus, worm, disabling code or other malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of this warranty shall be, at HDI's option, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Services, deliverable or software, and if HDI fails to do so within 30 days of written notice from the Company, a refund of the fees paid by the Company with respect to the non-conforming Services, deliverable or software.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 contains only mutual authority representations, so HDI gives no warranty for the development, hosting and maintenance work it is paid to perform. We have added our standard performance warranty: professional and workmanlike Services warranted for 90 days, the Site, deliverables and software conforming to documentation for 12 months, compliance with laws and no malicious code, with repair, replacement or refund as our remedy.
proposal.summary: Add an HDI performance warranty (professional and workmanlike Services for 90 days, 12-month conformance of the Site, deliverables and software to documentation, legal compliance, no malicious code) with repair, replacement and refund remedies.
